questions.question: In his prayer, what did Jesus say eternal life is?
options: Living forever in the bright and shining courts of heaven
Knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ whom he sent
Being washed and baptized in the pure and living water
Keeping every single one of the commandments perfectly
questions.answer: Knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ whom he sent
